title: installer-real-conflict-matrix
outOfScope: Provider configuration, secrets, release publication, and writes to a non-test adopter repository are excluded.
This Work Item does not alter installer conflict policy; it models and verifies existing conflict behavior.

sources.reason: User-approved WI-13 scenario and acceptance requirements.
Existing installer conflict and recovery behavior under test.

rawUserRequest: WI-13 installer-real-conflict-matrix: cover real installation conflicts including dirty worktrees, detached HEAD, existing governance files, symlinks, read-only paths, nested repositories, interrupted/concurrent installs, failed upgrades, and active Work Items. Classify every scenario as safe, warning, requires_review, or blocked; blocked scenarios must make zero writes and failures must recover to a provable original state.

declaredIntent.summary: Introduce an inspectable, read-only conflict matrix over existing installer behavior and exercise it with isolated filesystem and Git fixtures.

riskAssessment.reason: Conflict classification must remain read-only and must not weaken existing installer refusal or rollback behavior.

reasons: The work item changes installer safety evidence and tests while preserving existing policy.

executionDecision.reason: User supplied the required scenario matrix and authorized governed writes.

preReviewWarnings: Review that classification itself remains read-only and blocked cases create no target writes.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A read-only installer conflict matrix classifies every required WI-13 scenario as safe, warning, requires_review, or blocked.

Focused isolated fixtures cover dirty worktree, detached HEAD, existing .ai and AGENTS.md, reserved Make targets, symlink, read-only path, nested repository, submodule marker, case conflict, traversal, modified managed file, interrupted and concurrent installs, failed upgrade, and active Work Item.
Every blocked scenario proves zero writes; failure and rollback scenarios preserve or restore the original fixture state.
Installed lifecycle documentation distinguishes conflict inspection from approved installer transaction behavior.
guidelines: New public installer-domain APIs must be documented and tested.
Conflict inspection must be read-only; transaction authorization and installer policy remain in their existing domains.

intent.problem: The legacy installer already has scattered conflict defenses, but it does not expose a single read-only scenario matrix that lets maintainers verify which real installation conflicts are safe, warn, require review, or block before a transaction writes.
constraints: Preserve existing installer behavior and command compatibility.
Do not modify provider configuration or a non-test adopter repository.
Use only isolated temporary filesystem and Git fixtures for conflict simulation.
Blocked scenarios must make zero writes and recovery scenarios must retain provable original-state evidence.
Do not rewrite historical Work Item artifacts.
intent.rationale: A central read-only matrix turns implicit installer safety behavior into testable evidence without granting an inspection API authority to mutate an adopter repository.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: blocked conflict inspections make zero writes
scenarioCoverage.expected: Blocked path, symlink, conflict, and active-work-item cases produce no transaction writes.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Snapshot each isolated fixture before inspection and assert it is byte-for-byte unchanged after classification.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Dirty, detached, nested Git, submodule, read-only, case, traversal, and managed-file cases have stable classifications.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Build deterministic temporary Git and filesystem fixtures and assert each matrix row.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Interrupted, concurrent, and failed-upgrade scenarios preserve or restore source state.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run existing installer recovery fixtures alongside matrix classification and compare their pre/post state.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User explicitly authorized required Contract and governed Work Item writes for this and future Work Items.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
